items.title: Earlier main film: cube fabric, then real clicks on the live site
items.note: Passes film_qa at 176.7 s, 12.6 MiB, 67% real footage and 104 s of Eranos; one layer of words, reserved caption band, rings tracked per frame; all 1 fps sheets and the ring sheet reviewed, audio not heard; weak spots: the cube clips predate the film agent's base fixes (their old labels are painted out), no token card (the real token table is shown instead), and terminal runs aren't labeled as sped up.

items.title: Fabric Intelligence explained
items.note: 2:59. The live policy, Muse Glimmer 30B adapter results with their conditions, and a weight-editing test based on the MIT researchers' method that is only being set up: no result, nothing in production. Automatic checks and a look at frames; no person has listened yet.

items.title: Feeds explained
items.note: 2:17. Feeds as a type of Task, real feed pages and output, 26 of 30 on listed repositories, 0 of 6 on unlisted ones, and a plain agent with GitHub's API at 30 of 30 on fewer tokens. Automatic checks and a look at frames; no person has listened yet.

items.title: Cube fabric: camera and cube-size versions
items.note: Stills comparing a front view, fine terrain, tall city and sparse large cubes. Full films follow.

items.title: Cube fabric: first frames, your idea
items.note: Stills, not video yet. Two queues as pillars, five cube colors, and a different skyline for each Task. The full film is rendering.

items.title: Shimming explained
items.note: 2:09. Real live preview output, and today's small reach: 3 of 10 prompts matched, 1 direct answer. Savings from notes aren't measured. Automatic checks and a look at frames; no person has listened yet.

items.title: OmniNode explained
items.note: 2:59. Six parts, placement, joins, and the first six recorded runs of the feed maintenance OmniNode. Real records and real output are labeled; drawings are labeled Animation. It is a real trace, not a savings claim. Automatic checks and a look at frames; no person has listened yet.

items.title: Paper cut-out film
items.note: Layered paper hills and a blue shadow box that holds Fabric, with a green desk for Eranos. Weak spots: the hills get busy behind the box, and it reads a little storybook for an infrastructure product. Uses the earlier, longer script: compare the look, not the words.

items.title: Tabletop card game film
items.note: Fabric as a game on a table: two decks, a pawn and a mat, with a drifting camera and blurred near objects. Weak spots: card text is small at phone size and the camera can crop side labels while it pushes in. Uses the earlier, longer script: compare the look, not the words.

items.title: Simple 3D film, live in the browser
items.note: Rough pass, 3:00 with voice. Teleion Fabric as one bounded section with the three parts lit one at a time, then real Eranos pages on screens. Being improved: an empty moment at 2:27, and labels that collide on phones. Sound with picture hasn't been tested in real time.

items.title: Ray-traced communication blocks, first stills
items.note: Six still frames, not video yet. Tasks are blue blocks and Task Objects are black. Illustration. Motion is rendering now.
